system_prompt_style.evidence_quote:
Recent advances in AI agent engineering have demonstrated the viability of specialized agents wi th
distinct system prompts,
system_prompt_style.note: Paper-only evidence. The excerpt mentions distinct system prompts per agent but gives no mechanism, so the A1 paper-only rule applies (static, low). The quote is cited from related work, not from the system's own description.

env_context_strategy.note: Paper only, no repository or config surface. Memory and GPS context are injected, but there is no repository or environment context in the harness sense.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: older context is compressed via LLM-based summarization rather than being discarded
context_compaction.note: The fallback summary is built by truncating older user messages. Input is truncated to 2,000 characters.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Markdown rendering of AI responses is accomplished through ReactMarkdown version 10.1.0.
observation_format.note: Inferred; the paper does not describe the tool-result format.

tool_call_format.note: Paper only; the tool invocation syntax is not described.

tool_count.note: The paper names tools (voice call, SMS, audit log, Places API, web search) but gives no schema list.

edit_primitive.note: No tool registry is available; this is not a code-editing system.

protocol_standardization.note: Paper only; no dependency list or source to grep.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The central Orchestrator module receives user messages via a RESTful endpoint and executes a sequential processing pipeline.
loop_primitives.note: Seven-stage per-message pipeline with intent routing to agents.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: The central Orchestrator module receives user messages via a RESTful endpoint and executes a sequential processing pipeline.
planning_granularity.note: The pipeline stage list has no planning stage. This is paper-only evidence.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: the message is dispatched to one of four specialized agents or handled directly
multi_agent_topology.note: Supervisor routes to one of four domain agents.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: the message is dispatched to one of four specialized agents or handled directly
delegation_mechanism.note: Routing to an agent sharing the same session memory; closest value to role_handoff.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: a suspend -resume workflow pattern for human -in-the-loop confirmation

short_term_state.evidence_quote: stores metadata objects containing GPS coordinates, assessment state for multi -turn symptom screening, and the confirmation flag for the suspend -resume emergency workflow

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: persistent user profiles with episodic conversation summaries enabling personalized, context -aware interactions across sessions
long_term_memory.note: MongoDB Memory collection with facts and episodic summaries.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: a conversation session is retrieved or create d, binding the user to conversation context
state_persistence.note: Persistent MongoDB sessions resumed per message.

self_verification.note: The paper mentions 'AI generation verified through web sources' without describing a mechanism.

termination_condition.note: Single response per message; no loop termination is described.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: 20 requests per minute per user for chatbot endpoints
cost_controls.note: Rate limiting is the closest value; there is no explicit token budget.

execution_isolation.note: Tools are API calls; no execution boundary is described.

permission_model.evidence_quote: each agent can only invoke tools relevant to its domain, enforcing the principle of least priv ilege
permission_model.note: Emergency calls are also gated by user confirmation and a cooldown.

tracing.evidence_quote: The Audit Log Collection implements an immutable append-only log for clinical accoun tability

eval_hooks.note: Results table reported; no runner is described.

guardrails.evidence_quote: messages are truncated to 2,000 characters with HTML tag s tripping and control character removal
guardrails.note: The cooldown check blocks repeated emergency calls, which is coded as action_policies.

MindfulMother: AI Powered Maternal Mental
Health Support

open_source.note: No repo URL or licence was given.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: The LLM service is Google Gemini 2.0 Flash accessed via API

first_release_date.note: Paper published March 2026; exact date not given.
